entry.name: jit.qt.movie
entry.description: Use the jit.movie for working with movie files - playback, editing, import, export, effect generation and direct-to-video-output-component streaming.

attributes.digest: The portion of the output matrix written to by the input frame
attributes.description: The portion of the output matrix used for decompressing media to the internal matrix (default = 0 0 (matrix width) (matrix height))The bounds of the rectangle are expressed in the form. All values are relative to the top-left corner of the viewing area of the output matrix.

attributes.name: duration
attributes.description: The duration of the movie. When setting the duration, the entire movie will be scaled to the new length, unless the additional argumentis used. In that case, the movie length is changed without scaling. For more precise control of scaling, use themessage.

attributes.description: Unique frame filter flag (default = 0 (disabled)). When the flag is set, only new frames from the movie are output when the object receives a bang. If no new frame has been decompressed, theobject will not respond to the bang.

attributes.name: usedstrect
attributes.description: Destination rect flag (default = 0). When the flag is set, theattributes are used when copying an input matrix to the internal matrix.

messages.name: asyncread
messages.digest: Read a movie from a disk file asynchronously
messages.description: Asynchronously reads a movie from a disk file, if possible. If no argument is present, or if the symbolis used for theargument, a file selection dialog will be presented to choose a file. Any argument is assumed to be a local file name. At this time, asynchronous reading is not supported for URL- or clipboard-based movies; the normalbehavior will be used instead.

messages.name: cancelframedump
messages.description: Stops the frame dump process. See.

messages.name: framedump
messages.description: Commences a framedump, in which the movie will start from a frame specified by(the default is 1) and automatically output frames in sequence (noormessage is necessary) up to the frame specified by, skippingframes between each frame. The default values are 1 for the start frame, and the total framecount of the movie for the end frame. The defaultvalue is 1.During operation, the messageis sent out the right outlet after each frame has been output. When finished, the messageis output.

messages.name: read
messages.digest: Read a movie from a disk file/URL/clipboard
messages.description: Reads a movie from a disk file, URL or the clipboard. If no argument is present, or if the symbolis used for theargument, a file selection dialog will be presented to choose a file. If the argumentis used for theargument, the object will attempt to load a movie from the clipboard. If the argument is parsable as an http://, ftp:///, file://, or rtsp:// URL, the object will attempt to load a movie from that location. Otherwise, an argument is assumed to be a local file name.Ifis enabled, the movie will begin playing at once.
